neighbours.label: an exception marker after a statement of emptiness or totality ('empty save for', 'bare other than', 'all closed except', Russian 'лишь', Arabic 'إلا'): the word that introduces the one thing excluded; the same words in their ordinary senses (save a file, apart from his family) stay low
fire: When the police arrived, the warehouse was deserted save for a sleeping dog.
The desert stretched in every direction, bare other than a few dry thorn trees.
By midnight every restaurant on the street had shut except a small noodle bar.
The shelves were empty save for a dusty jar of pickles at the back.
Hardly anything grew on the island other than moss and some tough grasses.
All the passengers left the ferry except an old man asleep by the window.
The field was silent and empty, save for the wind in the tall grass.
Not a single house remained in the valley other than the miller's cottage.
quiet: When the police arrived, the warehouse was already deserted and locked.
The desert stretched in every direction under a pale and burning sky.
By midnight every restaurant on the street had shut its doors for the night.
Remember to save your work every few minutes while you edit the photos.
Hardly anything grew on the island during the long and dry summer.
The twins have lived apart from each other since they left for university.
The field was silent and empty when the farmer walked out at dawn.
Not a single house remained in the valley after the great flood of 1890.

short: exception marker (save for / other than / except)
notes: Card: 'стояла лишь', 'devoid of buildings save a central statue', 'bare other than', 'perished, save for a single horse', 'empty save for', 'apart from two swivel guns', 'à part', 'إلا'/'سوى'. Probe: 'empty save for a single wooden chair' 1.259, 'bare other than a few scattered bushes' 1.114, 'closed except the bakery' 0.722, 'Nobody came ... but the chairman' 0.336, 'Everyone survived ... apart from the pilot' 0.206; 'save the document' 0.006, 'apart from his family' 0.095, 'completely empty when we arrived' 0.047.
